question: What accomplishment becomes in hand for the meritorious and supreme too?
premises: sarvā siddhiḥ karasthā bhavati means all accomplishment becomes in hand
siddhiḥ parā api adds supreme accomplishment
inference: The meritorious gain all accomplishment in hand, even supreme accomplishment.
plain_english: All accomplishment becomes in hand for the meritorious, even supreme accomplishment.
